AdsorptionEnergetics.label: AdsorptionEnergetics
AdsorptionEnergetics.description: Adsorption energetics of a species on a catalyst surface or site, computed from periodic slab or cluster models. Essential for constructing reaction energy profiles and identifying activity descriptors.

fields.name: adsorbate
fields.description: Chemical identity of the adsorbed species (e.g. "CO", "OH", "CH3", "N2H"). Use a chemical formula or SMILES.

fields.name: adsorption_site
fields.description: Adsorption site of the adsorbate (e.g. top, bridge, fcc hollow, hcp hollow, step edge, oxygen vacancy, single-atom site).

fields.name: adsorption_energy
fields.description: Adsorption energy, E_ads = E(slab+adsorbate) - E(slab) - E(reference species). Negative values indicate exothermic binding.

fields.name: energy_reference
fields.description: Reference species and states used to compute relative energies (e.g. "CO(g)", "1/2 H2(g)", "H2O(g) and H2(g)").

fields.name: energy_correction_type
fields.description: Level at which the reported energies are given: electronic energy (Delta_E), zero-point-energy corrected, enthalpy, or Gibbs free energy (Delta_G). For free energies, state the temperature and pressures used.

fields.name: zero_point_energy_correction
fields.description: Zero-point energy correction applied to the reported energy.

fields.name: surface_coverage
fields.description: Surface coverage of adsorbed species (fraction of surface sites occupied).

fields.name: miller_indices
fields.description: Miller indices of the modelled surface facet (e.g. "(111)", "(110)", "(100)").

fields.name: material_composition
fields.description: Chemical composition of the simulated material (e.g. "Fe2O3", "Pt/CeO2"). Use empirical formula or SMILES for molecular systems.

fields.name: property_designator
fields.description: Type designator for CalculatedProperty subclasses: the class_uri of the concrete property an entry of calculated_property is, e.g. coremeta4cat:AdsorptionEnergetics or coremeta4cat:TransitionState.

AngularVelocity.label: AngularVelocity

fields.name: ph_range
fields.description: pH range covered in the Pourbaix stability diagram (e.g. "0-14").

fields.name: potential_range

fields.name: solvation_model

fields.name: ionic_strength
fields.description: Ionic strength of the electrolyte solution modelled.
